title: ㅋㅋㅋ = Korean “lol” 😂 …but just ONE ㅋ? Cold. #learnkorean
caption:
ㅋ (keu) sounds like a little laugh — so Koreans text ㅋㅋㅋ for “lol” 😂
The more ㅋ, the harder you’re laughing:
ㅋㅋ = 🙂
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ = 😄
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ = 🤣

But a single ㅋ can feel cold or sarcastic 😐 — send at least two!

Words in this video:
ㅋㅋㅋ (keu-keu-keu) = lol (laughing in texts)
…ㅋ? (keu?) = just one… cold

pinnedComment: How many ㅋ would you send for this video? 👇
alt: A needle-felt miniature story at night in two small rooms. In a peach-walled bedroom, Mongle, a coral felt blob mascot with no arms, finds a text from its Korean friend on a felt phone: ㅋㅋ. Puzzled, it reads keu-keu…? In a sage-green room the friend, a felt Korean young man in a grey hoodie, laughs harder and harder as he sends more ㅋ: ㅋㅋㅋㅋ, then eight of them. Mongle realises ㅋㅋㅋ means “lol” and happily sends back a single ㅋ. The friend’s smile turns flat and cold: Just ONE ㅋ? Panicking, Mongle presses the phone again and again, sending ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ — and big felt ㅋ letters pour out of the friend’s phone as he rolls on the floor laughing. Last line: more ㅋ = more 😂.
